parser_and_confidentiality_limits.record_matching: The observer requires one resolved bundle-manifest candidate, confines that manifest pointer to the selected data root, requires one manifest record for each selected basename, and then compares the exact resolved path. It is scoped to the three named payloads, not complete L6 admission.
known_bounded_limits: Default json.loads does not reject duplicate object keys.
The selected payload paths are compared to expected resolved paths, but the observer has no separate resolved-root containment assertion for each payload.
Before/after and post-set stat checks are enforced by the command, but only post-read stat snapshots are retained; the observation is marked non-atomic.
The G loader reads fixed JSON paths and hashes parsed objects but does not verify raw file bytes against root/final manifest declarations; the identity mismatch is not a demonstrated Runtime failure.
parser_and_confidentiality_limits.public_metadata_boundary: The committed stdout contains no payload bytes or individual payload hashes. It contains an absolute local reference to the ignored metadata-only report and the report's aggregate SHA-256. The committed L6 review records this as a bounded disclosure and recommends redaction before any wider export under a strict no-private-path/no-hash rule.
